ELECTIONS: This week, former prime minister Naftali Bennett came out in favor of public transportation on Shabbat, and civil marriage. Speaking with Army Radio, Bennett declared that “cities must be allowed to choose if they want public transportation on Shabbat” and that “every person in Israel should be able to bring their love to fruition in this country and not travel abroad.” For Bennett, the former political face of the socially conservative national-religious community, the announcements were the latest to underline what appears to be his ongoing move toward the center as he mounts a political comeback ahead of this year’s elections. At present, public transit is officially banned on Shabbat in nearly all Israeli cities, and Israelis who want a non-Orthodox Jewish wedding must tie the knot abroad, since the Chief Rabbinate holds a state monopoly on matrimony in Israel. Both issues are likely to resonate with a liberal, progressive audience that may have formerly viewed Bennett as anathema, even if they may alienate the religious conservatives he formerly counted as his voters. Read more on The Times of Israel.

On 22 April 2026, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, Secretary-General of ASEAN, received H.E. Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro, Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of the Philippines, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat for a high-level bilateral meeting and the ceremonial handover of the Philippines’ commemorative Chairship sculpture. Upon her arrival, Secretary Lazaro was received by Secretary-General Dr. Kao, the Committee of Permanent Representatives (CPRs), and the Deputy Secretaries-General of ASEAN. Following a commemorative photo session at the ASEAN Emblem, the principals proceeded to the ASEAN Gallery for a significant cultural ceremony. The highlight of the visit was the Handover of the Chairship Sculpture, a gift presented by the Republic of the Philippines to the ASEAN Secretariat. During the handover, Secretary Lazaro delivered her remarks on the inspiration and symbolism of the artwork, which serves as a tribute to the Philippines’ Chairship and leadership of ASEAN in 2026 and its enduring commitment to regional unity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao expressed his appreciation for the gift, which will be permanently housed in the ASEAN Gallery. Following the ceremony, Secretary-General Dr. Kao and Secretary Lazaro held a bilateral meeting to discuss strategic priorities and strengthen cooperation between the Philippines and the ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting discussed the Philippines’ priorities during its Chairship in 2026 amidst the global turmoil and energy crisis, as well as a range of key ASEAN issues in advancing the ASEAN Community building agenda. The visit concluded with a photo session at the Philippines Chairship Emblem in the lobby, where Secretary Lazaro also met with staff members from the Philippines currently serving at the ASEAN Secretariat. Why is Ibn Sahl left out of history? The Muslim genius who pioneered Snell's Law long before it was recognized. Ibn Sahl (d. 1000), was a Muslim mathematician and physicist, who flourished in Baghdad. He was the first to discover the law of refraction (Snell's law). Ibn Sahl uses this law to derive lens shapes that focus light with no geometric aberrations, known as anaclastic lenses. Ibn Sahl is the first Muslim scholar known to have studied Ptolemy's Optics. Ibn Sahl dealt with parabolic mirrors, ellipsoidal mirrors, biconvex lenses, and techniques for drawing hyperbolic arcs.

On 22 April 2026, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, Secretary-General of ASEAN, received H.E. Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro, Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of the Philippines, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat for a high-level bilateral meeting and the ceremonial handover of the Philippines’ commemorative Chairship sculpture. Upon her arrival, Secretary Lazaro was received by Secretary-General Dr. Kao, the Committee of Permanent Representatives (CPRs), and the Deputy Secretaries-General of ASEAN. Following a commemorative photo session at the ASEAN Emblem, the principals proceeded to the ASEAN Gallery for a significant cultural ceremony. The highlight of the visit was the Handover of the Chairship Sculpture, a gift presented by the Republic of the Philippines to the ASEAN Secretariat. During the handover, Secretary Lazaro delivered her remarks on the inspiration and symbolism of the artwork, which serves as a tribute to the Philippines’ Chairship and leadership of ASEAN in 2026 and its enduring commitment to regional unity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao expressed his appreciation for the gift, which will be permanently housed in the ASEAN Gallery. Following the ceremony, Secretary-General Dr. Kao and Secretary Lazaro held a bilateral meeting to discuss strategic priorities and strengthen cooperation between the Philippines and the ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting discussed the Philippines’ priorities during its Chairship in 2026 amidst the global turmoil and energy crisis, as well as a range of key ASEAN issues in advancing the ASEAN Community building agenda. The visit concluded with a photo session at the Philippines Chairship Emblem in the lobby, where Secretary Lazaro also met with staff members from the Philippines currently serving at the ASEAN Secretariat. Islamabad: 25 April 2026. Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif held a telephone call with His Excellency Dr. Masoud Pezeshkian, President of the Islamic Republic of Iran, this evening. During their warm and cordial conversation that lasted fifty minutes, the two leaders had a detailed exchange of views on the current regional situation and ongoing efforts to promote peace and stability in the region. He appreciated the participation of the high-level Iranian delegation in the talks held in Islamabad on 11-12 April 2026. He also welcomed Iran's decision to send a delegation led by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi to Islamabad, that held important meetings earlier today, including a detailed two-hour meeting with the Prime Minister. While sharing with the Iranian President an overview of his recent diplomatic outreach to a number of world leaders, the Prime Minister emphasized that these interactions had been helpful in building broader consensus in support of sustained dialogue and diplomacy aimed at achieving lasting peace in the war-affected region. The Prime Minister also expressed appreciation for the fruitful discussions conducted by the Iranian leadership with Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir during his recent visit to Tehran earlier this month. While reassuring the Iranian President of Pakistan's firm commitment to regional peace, the Prime Minister said that Pakistan would continue its sincere and honest endeavours to promote regional peace and security. President Pezeshkian thanked the Prime Minister, Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir and Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar for their significant contribution to the peace efforts. While expressing Iran's desire for peace, he also expressed confidence that the fraternal ties between Iran and Pakistan would continue to strengthen and expand in the future. The Prime Minister conveyed his respectful greetings and regards to the Supreme Leader, His Eminence Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei. Both leaders agreed to continue their close coordination.

Had a warm and constructive telephone exchange this evening with my brother, President Masoud Pezeshkian, on the evolving regional situation. American author Ernest Hemingway was undoubtedly one of the most famous cat lovers in the literary world, alongside Mark Twain, who adored cats so much that he avoided people who didn’t share his affection and even rented cats when he couldn’t bring his own on trips. Many are familiar with Hemingway’s home in Key West, Florida, which is now home to around 60 cats. His first polydactyl cat, named Snow White (or Snow), was a gift from a ship captain and sparked Hemingway’s lifelong love for these unique felines. Today, many of the cats at the Hemingway House are descendants of Snow, and they are lovingly cared for by the staff. The house is a must-visit destination for both literature enthusiasts and cat lovers. A charming tradition at the Hemingway House is that all the cats, following Snow, are named after famous figures, including Mark Twain, who was a significant literary influence on Hemingway. As Hemingway once said, “A cat has absolute emotional honesty: humans may hide their feelings, but a cat does not.” #archaeohistories

On 22 April 2026, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, Secretary-General of ASEAN, received H.E. Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro, Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of the Philippines, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat for a high-level bilateral meeting and the ceremonial handover of the Philippines’ commemorative Chairship sculpture. Upon her arrival, Secretary Lazaro was received by Secretary-General Dr. Kao, the Committee of Permanent Representatives (CPRs), and the Deputy Secretaries-General of ASEAN. Following a commemorative photo session at the ASEAN Emblem, the principals proceeded to the ASEAN Gallery for a significant cultural ceremony. The highlight of the visit was the Handover of the Chairship Sculpture, a gift presented by the Republic of the Philippines to the ASEAN Secretariat. During the handover, Secretary Lazaro delivered her remarks on the inspiration and symbolism of the artwork, which serves as a tribute to the Philippines’ Chairship and leadership of ASEAN in 2026 and its enduring commitment to regional unity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao expressed his appreciation for the gift, which will be permanently housed in the ASEAN Gallery. Following the ceremony, Secretary-General Dr. Kao and Secretary Lazaro held a bilateral meeting to discuss strategic priorities and strengthen cooperation between the Philippines and the ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting discussed the Philippines’ priorities during its Chairship in 2026 amidst the global turmoil and energy crisis, as well as a range of key ASEAN issues in advancing the ASEAN Community building agenda. The visit concluded with a photo session at the Philippines Chairship Emblem in the lobby, where Secretary Lazaro also met with staff members from the Philippines currently serving at the ASEAN Secretariat. I recently got access to OpenAI’s Trusted Access for Cyber program. With all the GPT-5.5 hype and the Anthropic Mythos discussion, I wanted to test it for myself. The result: **GPT-5.4** helped identify and develop a working Safari exploit affecting all Apple devices. It found a JSC WebAssembly use-after-free that gave us stale read/write access inside the Primitive Gigacage. Then it spotted a bug in Safari’s Fetch implementation where in-flight opaque cross-origin responses could be materialized inside renderer memory. By combining the two, a malicious page could steal authenticated cross-origin data and completely defeat the Same-Origin Policy. Video

Naval Science & Technological Laboratory(NSTL), DRDO in collaboration with Warship Design Bureau of Indian Navy has successfully completed Hydrodynamic Performance Assessment and Model Testing of Frontline Indian Naval Ship Project. Comprehensive capabilities were demonstrated in Hull hydrodynamic, CFD based simulation and experimental model testing, covering critical parameters such as resistance, propulsion, sea keeping and manoeuvrability. The outcomes were benchmarked against leading international standard, establishing parity in accuracy, reliability and technical depth. The formal handing over of project deliverables were carried out by Dr Samir V Kamat Secretary DDR&D and Chairman DRDO to VAdm Sanjay Sadhu, AVSM, NM, Controller of Warship Production and Acquisition in presence of Dr RV Hara Prasad DG(N&SM), Dr B K Das, DG (ECS), Dr Abraham Varughese, Director NSTL from DRDO and RAdm Sujit Baxi, DG(WDB), RAdm Iftekhar Alam, NM, ADG( WDB) from Indian Navy

🙏🇵🇱 This week in Warsaw, I received the special award of @PressClubPolska, which was an incredibly moving experience for me in several respects. The official justification for the award: "The Council of Press Club Polska has awarded a special prize to Szabolcs Panyi, a Hungarian investigative journalist working for the independent outlets Direkt36 and VSquare. 'With this year's special award, we pay tribute to the unwavering professional integrity of a journalist who, despite the threat of legal consequences, did not back down and published the investigative report exposing the compromising conduct of representatives of the Hungarian government' — explained Wojciech Tumidalski, Chairman of the PCP Council, in justifying the decision." As I said in my speech: over the past ten years, I have gradually become a participant in Polish media alongside Hungarian journalism. Beyond the fact that my family name and ancestors originate from Poland, I have been collaborating for nearly ten years with the Warsaw-based non-profit journalism foundation @FReporterow, publisher of the English-language @VSquare_Project and the Polish @FRONTSTORY_PL investigative sites. Both professionally and personally, I owe an enormous debt to my editors and dear friends, @agielewska and Wojtek Cieśla. I also said that in the final weeks before the fall of the Orbán regime, during the smear campaign launched against me and the legal and political threats I faced, I received extraordinary support from my Polish editors and colleagues, as well as from the entire Polish journalism community, for which I am deeply grateful. The current award was given to me for the Polish-Hungarian stories I have uncovered in recent years — such as exposing the Budapest hideout of Daniel Obajtek, the former CEO of Orlen — but primarily for the investigative articles about the communications between Hungarian foreign minister Péter Szijjártó and Sergey Lavrov. The latter were also written together with my Polish colleagues, in our Warsaw editorial office. A particular source of pride is that at the Press Club Polska awards ceremony, my Polish colleagues from VSquare/FRONTSTORY also won the award for the highest-quality journalistic achievement, and were finalists for the best investigation of the year award as well (having taken home that prize in each of the two preceding years). Huge congrats also to @DanielFlis, @nst_morozova, Alicja Pawłowska, Radosław Łukasik, Wojciech Cieśla, @MateuszKapera, @ma_panko, Dominik Szczepański, @k_wysota, Michał Żyłowski and the whole team involved in these great projects.

বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজায় নারীদের জন্য বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা ঢাকা, ৩০ ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫: বাংলাদেশ জাতীয়তাবাদী দল (বিএনপি)-এর চেয়ারপার্সন, তিনবারের সাবেক প্রধানমন্ত্রী ও গণতান্ত্রিক রাজনীতির শীর্ষ নেত্রী বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার ইন্তেকালে দেশব্যাপী গভীর শোকের আবহ বিরাজ করছে। তাঁর প্রতি শেষ শ্রদ্ধা জানাতে সর্বস্তরের মানুষের অংশগ্রহণ নিশ্চিত করতে প্রয়োজনীয় প্রস্তুতি গ্রহণ করা হয়েছে অন্তর্বর্তীকালীন সরকার। এই প্রেক্ষাপটে বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজায় অংশগ্রহণ করতে ইচ্ছুক নারীদের জন্য বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা রাখা হয়েছে। জাতীয় সংসদ ভবনের দক্ষিণ প্লাজা ও মানিক মিয়া এভিনিউ এলাকায় নারীদের জন্য পৃথকভাবে এ বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা করা হয়েছে, যাতে তাঁরা সুশৃঙ্খল ও নিরাপদ পরিবেশে জানাজায় অংশ নিতে পারেন। উল্লেখ্য, বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজা বাদ জোহর বেলা দুইটায় অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। জানাজায় অংশগ্রহণে আগ্রহী সকলকে নিরাপত্তাজনিত কারণে কোনো প্রকার ব্যাগ বহন না করার জন্য অনুরোধ জানানো হচ্ছে। বেগম খালেদা জিয়াকে শেষ বিদায় জানাতে আগত সকলের সার্বিক নিরাপত্তা ও শৃঙ্খলা নিশ্চিত করতে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষ প্রয়োজনীয় সব ধরনের ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করেছে।

Chaired a detailed discussion on the Urban Challenge Fund with State Urban Development Ministers and Secretaries, to review its forward strategy and implementation priorities. The Urban Challenge Fund marks a decisive shift in India’s urban development approach, moving beyond traditional grants to leverage public funds to crowd in significantly higher investment. With cities playing a central role in driving growth, innovation, and employment, their preparedness will be critical to achieving the vision of Viksit Bharat. This calls for improved planning, stronger governance, and sustainable financing practices. Also encouraged States and Urban Local Bodies to deepen reforms, enhance their financial capacity, and actively adopt market-based financing. The Fund offers a clear opportunity to develop resilient, competitive, and investment-ready urban ecosystems. #UrbanChallengeFund

The 4th Annual U.S.-Pakistan Conference at Georgetown University @Georgetown was co-hosted by the International Academy of Letters USA and the Walsh School of Foreign Service, Georgetown University. The Conference explored Pakistan’s geopolitical landscape, security dynamics, economic opportunities and potential, as well as human and social development challenges, with an eye on solutions. In his remarks, the Ambassador underscored Pakistan’s strategic relevance - highlighting geographic linkages with the Middle East, longstanding and consistent role in promoting global peace, and transition from a geopolitics-driven to a geoeconomics-focused foreign policy approach. He also emphasized Pakistan’s position as a vital economic corridor connecting China, Central Asia, and the Gulf; its history of constructive contributions to regional and global peace; and the current confidence placed in its diplomatic engagement by the international community. The Conference brought together leading experts and practitioners for in-depth discussions and a productive exchange of ideas on the way forward.

And then there are individuals to whom history belongs. Today, we have gathered here to light a lamp for a distinguished citizen who once carried 400 million hungry hearts on his thin, even trembling shoulders and never once let them fall. On the 2nd of October, 1904, in a small, rain-soaked home in Mughalsarai, a child was born to a widowed mother who had nothing to give him, no wealth, no name, no inheritance. When young Lal Bahadur was perhaps 9 or 10 years old, he had to cross the Ganga every day to reach his school on the other side. He had no money to pay the boatman, so he swam across the Ganga every single day. No law said that he had to go to school. No law said the river would not kill him. Nahuel Hilal - TattooGuy (@nahuelhilal) Yesterday I drove my @tesla 900 miles on FSD from Miami to Nashville and I realized it’s genuinely the better option. I fly that route 2 to 3 times a month. Flights are never under $400. Most times $600. Sometimes $800. Add Uber to and from both airports, or parking garage fees. Then factor in the delays, the cancellations, the security theater, the chaos, the guy next to you who hasn’t met deodorant yet. On the other hand: I pack healthy snacks, press one button, and the car just goes. I took calls. Replied to emails. FaceTimed my family. Ate without pulling over. Did everything I normally do on a travel day, except none of the stuff that makes travel days miserable. My biggest concern going in was range and charging. Here’s what actually happened: My bladder needed one extra stop the car didn’t even suggest. Most charging stops were under five minutes. Total cost for the whole trip was less than just the uber to the airport. And this was the base model Y. Religious Scholars Are Those Whom Allah Has Made Witnesses to His Oneness: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Addresses Scholarly Gathering in Oslo Oslo, Norway: His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri and Prof. Dr. Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri, Chairman Supreme Council of Minhaj-ul-Quran International, participated in a special scholarly session organized in honor of religious scholars at the Islamic Center Minhaj-ul-Quran International, Oslo. On this occasion, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a detailed address on the virtues and responsibilities of religious scholars. He stated that religious scholars are, in reality, those distinguished personalities whom Almighty Allah has made witnesses to His Oneness and truth. He emphasized that their true identity lies in being “Qaim bil-Qist”—those who remain steadfast upon justice and fairness at all times and never deviate from the demands of justice in any matter. While continuing his address, Shaykh-ul-Islam stressed that scholarly discourse must always be based on sound research and strong evidence. Explaining the proper order of scholarly reasoning, he stated that priority must first be given to the Holy Qur’an, followed by the Prophetic Hadith (peace and blessings be upon him), then Ijma (consensus) and Qiyas (analogical reasoning), and finally Ijtihad and personal opinion, as maintaining this order is essential for preserving academic and scholarly standards. During the session, Shaykh-ul-Islam also responded to various scholarly and research-based questions raised by the participants. The gathering was attended by a large number of scholars from different schools of thought, including Mufti Tahir Aziz, Hafiz Sadaqat Ali Qadri, Hafiz Safdar Ali, Qari Ansar Ali Qadri, Mufti Zubair Tabassum, Allama Arshad Zia, Haroon Qayyum, Allama Kaukab Noorani, Allama Muhammad Jameel Mortensrud, Allama Najeeb-ur-Rehman Naz, Allama Naseer Ahmad Noori, Allama Noor Ahmad Noor, Syed Nehmat Ali Shah, Syed Firasat Ali Bukhari, Qari Muhammad Aslam, Qari Israr Ahmad, Qari Jahangir Drammen, Qari Mahmood-ul-Hasan, Qari Noor Ali Sialvi, Syed Zawar Hussain Naqvi, Qari Rehmat Ilahi, Syed Shamshad Rizvi, Allama Hamid Farooq, Allama Nasir Ali, Qari Shiraz Madani, Syed Hasnain Gilani, Qari Ahmad Bilal Shah, Allama Inam Awan, Qari Zia-ul-Hasnain, Masoom Zubair, Syed Hassan Rizvi, Allama Saleem Alvi, Allama Javed, Allama Bashir Ahmad, Allama Ateeq-ur-Rehman, Allama Abid Kashmiri, Faisal Qayyum, Syed Bilal Imtiaz Shah, Qari Syed Farid, and many other scholars and spiritual leaders from Oslo and surrounding areas. This week, I was in London to deepen @IFAD’s partnership with the #UK at a pivotal moment for food security and development cooperation. I met Minister Baroness @JennyChapman , UK Minister of State for International Development and Africa to advance shared priorities. This includes #IFAD14 and accelerating blended finance solutions that mobilize private capital at scale for agri-SMEs and underserved rural communities, including in fragile settings. Together with @WFP and @FAO we discussed the impact of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz on local and global food systems and prices. The current situation in the Middle East presents a systematic global shock through maritime trade, energy and fertilizer prices. Quick action and strong alignment between the RBAs, IFIs, Government, and other partners is crucial to absorb these external shocks and reduce the impact on the #FirstMile. I also met with Lord Jonathan Oates, Members of the House of Lords and CEO of @UnitedAMH to highlight how strategic investment in rural transformation and food systems can deliver nutrition outcomes at scale. Redefining development finance requires scaling innovative instruments that deliver measurable impact, strengthen multilateral action and ensure value for money where it matters most. #FinancingTheFirstMile #IFADImpact @FCDOGovUK

বান্দরবান জেলার লামায় অপহৃত ৬ রাবার বাগান শ্রমিক সেনাবাহিনীর অপারেশনে উদ্ধার ঢাকা, ২৪ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ (শুক্রবার): গত ২৩ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ তারিখে লামা উপজেলার হাতিরডেরা–টংকাবতী এলাকায় অপহরণের শিকার রাবার বাগান শ্রমিকদের উদ্ধারে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর একাধিক টহল দল তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে অভিযান শুরু করে। দিন-রাতব্যাপী নিবিড় অনুসন্ধান ও তল্লাশি অভিযানের ফলে সেনাবাহিনীর উপস্থিতি টের পেয়ে অপহরণকারীরা অপহৃতদের পাহাড়ে ফেলে রেখে পালিয়ে যায়। পরবর্তীতে দিনের আলো ফোঁটার পর সেনাবাহিনীর টহল দল তাদের নিরাপদে উদ্ধার করে। উদ্ধারকৃত সকল ব্যক্তিকে আইনানুগ প্রক্রিয়া অনুসরণ করে পরিবারের কাছে হস্তান্তর করা হবে। সংশ্লিষ্ট থানা এ বিষয়ে অবহিত রয়েছে। পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামের সকল জনগোষ্ঠীর নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিতে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর এ ধরনের অভিযান অব্যাহত থাকবে। দেশের শান্তি ও জনসাধারণের নিরাপত্তা রক্ষায় বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী সর্বদা দৃঢ় প্রতিজ্ঞ।

केन्द्रीय बौद्ध अध्ययन संस्थान (CIBS), लेह में आयोजित विभिन्न शैक्षणिक, अवसंरचनात्मक एवं सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों में सहभागिता की। इस दौरान नवनिर्मित 100 बेडेड यांगचन ल्हामो (सरस्वती) गर्ल्स हॉस्टल का उद्घाटन किया, जिससे छात्राओं के लिए बेहतर आवासीय सुविधाएँ उपलब्ध होंगी। इस क्रम में सोवा रिग्पा अस्पताल एवं संबद्ध कॉलेज के लिए प्रस्तावित तीन मंजिला भवन के निर्माण हेतु भूमिपूजन किया। यह परियोजना पारंपरिक चिकित्सा पद्धति सोवा रिग्पा के संरक्षण और विस्तार की दिशा में महत्वपूर्ण कदम है। साथ ही सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम में लद्दाख की समृद्ध सांस्कृतिक एवं बौद्ध परंपराओं की झलक देखने को मिली। वर्ष 1962 से संस्कृति मंत्रालय द्वारा निरंतर सहयोग प्राप्त कर यह संस्थान आज एक विशाल वटवृक्ष का रूप ले चुका है। 'डीम्ड टू बी यूनिवर्सिटी' का दर्जा प्राप्त कर तथा राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 की भावना के अनुरूप यह संस्थान माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी के विकसित भारत के संकल्प को साकार करने की दिशा में भी विशेष भूमिका निभा रहा है।

Тим не менш був випадок, коли в самій реальній кілзоні, де і менші помилки караються, велика група росіян вийшла і почала розвантажувати щось. Чи то вони самі приїхали, чи то їм щось привезли, не можу сказати. Бачив уже тільки закінчення вистави. Ну так от, реально цілий взвод за кілька км від дружніх позицій щось там розвантажує. Залітає на територію об'єкта офігівший пілот суміжників, бачить всю цю картину... Почули вони його раніше і... майже всі ломанулись у один вузький прохід. Лише декілька згадали базові речі про розосередження і кинулися в протилежний бік. Об'єкт промисловий, капітальні бетонні будівлі, звісно укриття там якісне, тож бажання потрапити саме туди, куди заносили і майно і самі мали зайти/повернутися, зрозуміти нескладно. Офігівший від такого нахабства чи від щастя (коли ще таке можна побачити, зараз власне ніколи) пілот, спрямовує дрон прямо в цей безладний натовп, у проході, вибиваючи страйк. Всі в шоці. Звісно зараз такого свята на такій відстані чекати в принципі не можна. Просочування чи проскакування на легкому транспорті - це малі групи. Часто просто по одному ходять. Аж ніяк не 2-3 десятки нахабних морд прямо під носом за мірками сучасного покриття дронами. Біс його знає як вони таке допустили. Може сподівалися проскочити швидко, а може ще не мали досвіду. Така думка гризе мене, адже розосередження в таких ситуаціях річ базова і противник навчає своїх бійців цьому. The Ad-Hoc Senior Officials Meeting on Energy (SOME) Preparatory Meeting for the Special ASEAN Ministers on Energy Meeting (AMEM), together with the Ad-Hoc SOME Consultative Session with Dialogue Partners, were convened on 24 April 2026 in a virtual format under the Philippines’ ASEAN Chairmanship. The Meetings brought together Senior Energy Officials from all ASEAN Member States, the ASEAN Secretariat, the ASEAN Centre for Energy (ACE), the ASEAN Council on Petroleum (ASCOPE), and key ASEAN energy bodies, alongside Dialogue Partners. The ASEAN Secretariat delegation was led by the Deputy Secretary-General for the ASEAN Economic Community, H.E. Satvinder Singh. The Meetings were convened at a critical juncture to assess the implications of the evolving situation in the Middle East on global and regional energy markets, particularly on oil and gas supply stability, price volatility, and supply chain disruptions. Discussions underscored the urgency of strengthening ASEAN’s collective preparedness and response mechanisms, while reinforcing regional solidarity and coordinated policy actions. Key deliberations focused on the operationalisation of the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Petroleum Security (APSA), including accelerating domestic ratification processes, advancing interim coordination arrangements, and exploring the establishment of a Coordinated Emergency Response Mechanism (CERM). The Meetings also discussed concrete measures to enhance regional energy resilience, including supply diversification, demand-side management, strategic stockpiling, and strengthened coordination among ASEAN energy bodies, supported by financing initiatives from the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group. Engagement with Dialogue Partners provided valuable insights into global supply risks and opportunities for practical cooperation. Discussions highlighted potential collaboration on emergency supply assurance, LNG and crude oil access, market flexibility, renewable energy deployment, energy efficiency, and real-time information sharing. These exchanges reinforced ASEAN’s commitment to ensuring that partnerships remain demand-driven, targeted, and responsive to regional priorities. The Meetings also progressed the preparation and finalisation of the Joint Statement of the Special AMEM, which is expected to reflect ASEAN’s collective commitment to safeguarding energy security, enhancing resilience, and ensuring timely and coordinated responses to emerging global challenges. What better can I do than to relive and share the pre-foundation day memories of our party. I wrote to Mr @ImranKhanPTI in Feb 1996, after reading that he may form a political party. Then I met him on 20th April 1996 and wrote this 2nd letter to him to help prepare for the Press Conference that was held to announce PTI on 26th April 1996 exactly thirty years ago. April 22, 1996 Mr. Mahmud Ali, Shaukat Khanum Memorial Trust, 7-A, Block R-3, Johar Town, Lahore. Urgent: Please deliver to Mr Imran Khan Dear Mr Mahmud Ali, I was visiting Lahore in connection with the examination of MCPS candidates which I was conducting at the De’Montmorency College of Dentistry. I met Mr. Imran Khan on 20th April at his office at SKMT. We had an hour-long discussion. He expressed the desire that I stay back for the Press Conference on Thursday but as I had to be back in Karachi to conduct another exam I regretted. I promised to send him my suggestions before the press conference. A base line message which Imran intends to deliver on Thursday is essential together with a working paper. Troubled sections of our country need to be identified with solutions to their problems. I feel that a lot of work has to be done at the grass roots level. There are certain problems at the core which have been identified by Imran very clearly which is lack of honest leadership in the country. However, our simple minded people suffering severe disenfranchisement need to be addressed directly irrespective of what is being said on the broad wave length of propaganda. The problems of the Mazdoor and Kissan have not been addressed since the demise of the left, and in Pakistan these words which were uttered continuously in every speech and by every leader whether from the left or the right, seem to have been stricken of the political dictionary. Capital which was the devil of yesterday is the savior today. A balance has to be struck for regarding the wellbeing of our trampled masses. Business is being given confused signals. Zardari-ism and corruption do not allow any stability in industry. ‘Dealership’ rather than leadership is in vogue. The stock market is weak because of wrong business policies as well as the prevailing uncertainties in the country. Agricultural exemption of taxation needs to be addressed very vigorously, in which case the new party may lose the rural support of the landed gentry, but gain that of the exploited rural farmer. The absence of meritocracy has to be addressed in a more comprehensive manner. Most people may not be aware that the issue is simple enough to demand immediate clear cut attitudinal decisions. The system is built on non-merit and nepotism. Ad-hocism itself allows appointments on a temporary non-selectional basis, all of which are regularised later without exception. Lack of accountability, about which Imran has talked a few times, may need a system with teeth, either at the judicial level by legislating faster judicial processes, as well as by making the office of the ombudsman much bigger and more effective. The What? and How? of the approach needs some work by us. I have tried to highlight a few issues, not to prescribe solutions, but just to make Imran aware that some work needs to be done on scientific and intellectual levels. A manifesto needs to be framed urgently because even to sell a good product, a variety of flowers need to be added to bouquets for different sections of society. Every person should be able to smell the fragrance of his choice in our landscape. Yours sincerely, Dr. Arif R. Alvi #PTIFoundationDay

David Friedberg on the Nonprofit Scam: 90% Are Bullsh*t “ The definition of exempt activities is charitable, religious, educational, scientific, literacy, public safety, or fostering amateur sports competition, or preventing cruelty to children or animals. You tell me how the f**k 90% of what we call nonprofits today fall under that definition. We have completely f**king closed our eyes to the fact that organizations, regardless of political affiliation or social interest, have fundamental commercial and probably not aligned interests with the definition of a 501(c)(3), and we've allowed them all to get away with it for far too long. I don't think that this is a blue or red thing. I think that this is a thing where we let these organizations make it easy to get money, to hide the money, and to do whatever the hell they want with the money, and we need to stop it. And I think that it's an amazing opportunity right now for everyone to kind of reset the decks by cleaning all the sh*t up, and getting all of these organizations flushed, and make sure that any organization that wants to do whatever bullsh*t, nefarious things they want to do, by all means do it. But it's not a nonprofit and you shouldn't get a charitable donation deduction, and the government should not be putting money into these sorts of things. This is an entirely different sort of activity in the social order. And as a libertarian, I'm all for it, but I don't think that they should be tax exempt, and I don't think they should be getting government money, and I don't think that individuals should be benefiting from giving them money. And if we could fix all that shit up, I think a lot of these problems are going to go away.” Video

این ویدیو از یک سرقت مسلحانه در شهر لشکرگاه، مرکز هلمند، به روزنامه اطلاعات روز ارسال شده است. در ویدیو دیده می‌شود که دو نفر، که یکی از آنان مسلح است، با پیاده‌شدن از یک موتر، دو جوان را لت‌وکوب و موتورسایکل و وسایل آنان را سرقت می‌کنند. این ویدیو حوالی ساعت ۱۱:۰۰ پیش‌ازچاشت روز پنج‌شنبه (۳ ثور) توسط یک دوربین مداربسته ضبط شده است. ارسال‌کننده‌ی ویدیو می‌‌گوید که این دو جوان در حال توزیع کارت عروسی به خانه‌های بستگان‌شان در منطقه‌ی «کارته لگان» شهر لشکرگاه بودند که هدف حمله‌ی سارقان مسلح قرار گرفتند. به‌گفته‌ی او، سرقت مسلحانه در این اواخر در شهر لشکرگاه افزایش چشم‌گیر یافته است و باعث ایجاد ترس و نگرانی برای مردم شده است. در روزهای اخیر ویدیوهایی از سرقت مسلحانه در شماری از ولایت‌های دیگر کشور نیز منتشر شده است. این سرقت‌ها در روز روشن و در حالی انجام می‌شوند که طالبان ادعا می‌کنند که امنیت سراسری را در کشور تأمین کرده‌اند. उत्तर प्रदेश के ग़ाज़ीपुर में विश्वकर्मा समाज की एक बेटी के साथ बलात्कार और निर्मम हत्या - और फिर परिवार को FIR दर्ज कराने से रोकने के लिए धमकियाँ, हिंसा। हाथरस, कठुआ, उन्नाव और आज ग़ाज़ीपुर - यह एक पैटर्न है। मणिपुर की बेटी ने न्याय की राह देखते-देखते दम तोड़ दिया। हर बार वही चेहरा - पीड़िता दलित, पिछड़ी, आदिवासी, ग़रीब। हर बार वही सच्चाई - अपराधी को संरक्षण, पीड़ित को प्रताड़ना। हर बार वही चुप्पी - सत्ता की, जिन्हें बोलना चाहिए था। जिस देश और प्रदेश में माँ-बाप को अपनी बेटी की FIR लिखवाने के लिए भीख माँगनी पड़े, उस देश की सरकार को सत्ता में रहने का कोई नैतिक अधिकार नहीं। दोषी पुलिस अफ़सरों पर कार्रवाई हो, परिवार को सुरक्षा मिले - उच्च स्तरीय जांच हो और तुरंत न्याय मिले। मोदी जी, मुख्यमंत्री जी जवाब दीजिए - आपके राज में बेटियाँ इतनी असुरक्षित क्यों हैं? ऐसे हालात में न्याय माँगा नहीं, छीना जाता है - और हम छीनकर लाएँगे।

On 22 April 2026, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, Secretary-General of ASEAN, received H.E. Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro, Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of the Philippines, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat for a high-level bilateral meeting and the ceremonial handover of the Philippines’ commemorative Chairship sculpture. Upon her arrival, Secretary Lazaro was received by Secretary-General Dr. Kao, the Committee of Permanent Representatives (CPRs), and the Deputy Secretaries-General of ASEAN. Following a commemorative photo session at the ASEAN Emblem, the principals proceeded to the ASEAN Gallery for a significant cultural ceremony. The highlight of the visit was the Handover of the Chairship Sculpture, a gift presented by the Republic of the Philippines to the ASEAN Secretariat. During the handover, Secretary Lazaro delivered her remarks on the inspiration and symbolism of the artwork, which serves as a tribute to the Philippines’ Chairship and leadership of ASEAN in 2026 and its enduring commitment to regional unity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao expressed his appreciation for the gift, which will be permanently housed in the ASEAN Gallery. Following the ceremony, Secretary-General Dr. Kao and Secretary Lazaro held a bilateral meeting to discuss strategic priorities and strengthen cooperation between the Philippines and the ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting discussed the Philippines’ priorities during its Chairship in 2026 amidst the global turmoil and energy crisis, as well as a range of key ASEAN issues in advancing the ASEAN Community building agenda. The visit concluded with a photo session at the Philippines Chairship Emblem in the lobby, where Secretary Lazaro also met with staff members from the Philippines currently serving at the ASEAN Secretariat. The 4th Annual U.S.-Pakistan Conference at Georgetown University @Georgetown was co-hosted by the International Academy of Letters USA and the Walsh School of Foreign Service, GWU. The Conference explored Pakistan’s geopolitical landscape, security dynamics, economic opportunities and potential, as well as human and social development challenges, with an eye on solutions. In his remarks, the Ambassador underscored Pakistan’s strategic relevance - highlighting geographic linkages with the Middle East, longstanding and consistent role in promoting global peace, and transition from a geopolitics-driven to a geoeconomics-focused foreign policy approach. He also emphasized Pakistan’s position as a vital economic corridor connecting China, Central Asia, and the Gulf; its history of constructive contributions to regional and global peace; and the current confidence placed in its diplomatic engagement by the international community. The Conference brought together leading experts and practitioners for in-depth discussions and a productive exchange of ideas on the way forward.

❓This week, we answer a question about education that you submitted through our Info Finder tool: ➡ #YouAsked: What is the current proportion of male and female school principals in South Africa? 📊 There is no publicly available data on the gender breakdown of all school principals, but researchers have calculated estimates. A 2024 international survey found that in South Africa, 66% of principals were male, and 34% female. This included teachers and principals working across 361 schools that provided lower secondary education (Grades 8 and 9). ❗ A larger study looked at public payroll data from over 380,000 teachers, principals and deputy principals in the public sector between 2012 and 2021. It found that 70% of educators were women, but only 39% of principals were women. This gender gap has changed very little since 2012.

CÓMO EL EJERCICIO AERÓBICO REGULAR PUEDE AYUDAR A REDUCIR EL ESTRÉS Y PROTEGER EL CEREBRO Desde hace años, la ciencia sugiere que moverse más hace bien. Sin embargo, ahora un estudio aporta una evidencia más concreta, no solo mejora el ánimo en el momento, sino que también modifica procesos profundos del cuerpo vinculados al estrés y al envejecimiento cerebral. Una investigación publicada en el Journal of Sport and Health Science reveló que realizar ejercicio aeróbico de forma constante reduce de manera sostenida el cortisol —conocido como la hormona del estrés— y contribuye a proteger el cerebro con el paso del tiempo. Se trata del primer ensayo clínico aleatorizado de larga duración que demuestra una relación directa entre la actividad física regular, la disminución del estrés biológico y el cuidado de las funciones cerebrales. His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri, Prof. Dr. Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri, Chairman Supreme Council, MQI, and Dr. Ghazala Qadri visited Central Jamaat-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat Oslo today to offer the Friday prayer. The prayer was led by Shaykh Syed Nehmat Ali Shah, Imam of Central Jamaat-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat. Following the Friday prayer, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered nasiha (words of wisdom) to the gathering. His Eminence Shaykh ul Islam emphasized how faith can become a natural part of a child’s inner being when the proper environment is created to nurture this development from within. The Qur’an describes religion as part of human nature; however, Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that this innate nature must be activated through conscious choices. Shaykh ul Islam highlighted that parents carry a special responsibility to create an environment in which faith can grow. Faith does not develop in isolation—it must be awakened. Just as a child naturally learns to cry, faith too is innate within human beings. Without the right environment, a person may lose their identity—like a lion raised among goats. Therefore, children must be nurtured through positive surroundings from an early stage, even before birth. His Eminence further stated that the character of parents plays a decisive role, as children are influenced by what they see and hear. Respect, calmness, and positive attitudes are therefore essential in shaping a child’s personality. In his concluding message to the public, Shaykh-ul-Islam advised focusing on the good in others and striving to improve oneself, as this strengthens both a child’s character and faith. We extend our gratitude to Zahid Aslam, Chairman of Central Jamaat-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat, Shaykh Syed Nehmat Ali Shah, Imam of Central Jam-e Masjid Ahl-e-Sunnat, and Mufti Zubair Tabassum for their hospitality and warm reception. Representatives from MQI Norway were also present, including Imam and Director MQI Norway Allama Muhammad Iqbal Fani, Afzal Ansari (Ameer-e-Tehreek), Awais Ejaz Ahmed (President MQI), Hassan Bashir (General Secretary MQI), Pervaiz Nisar (Head, House of Representatives MQI), Arfan Ansari (President MQI Oslo), Asif Javed (President Minhaj Cultural Center Kløfta), and Shafique Siddique (President Minhaj Cultural Center Drammen).

The U.S. operates differently, using abundant natural gas instead of oil, which allows it to sidestep the disruption. The result is a widening gap where American producers gain dominance while others struggle to maintain output. Glad to share an extremely good news: After a considerably long ordeal of 12 long years, all accused including myself have been acquitted honourably in the famous Khirki case of the year 2014 which was lodged against me and 17 other residents of Khirki, Jahapanah and Hauzrani for the alleged acts against drug mafia and human traffickers belonging to Uganda and other South African Countries. Honble Judge Ms Neha Mittal, Ld JFMC, Rouse Avenue Courts, while pronouncing the acquittal, said: 1. Statements under sec 164 are inadmissible. 2. Prosecution has failed to explain the delay in lodging the FIR. 3. Prosecution has failed to establish allegation of unlawful assembly. 4. Prosecution has failed to establish identity of the alleged victims. 5. Prosecution has failed to prove its case. We have always maintained that this was a false and politically motivated prosecution. I am grateful that the Honble Court has upheld the rule of law. I am deeply grateful to veteran criminal lawyer Shri S. P. Kaushal for the impeccable manner in which he conducted the trial. His clarity of thought, command over law, and unwavering commitment were truly exemplary. I also thank Sri Rakesh Saini, Sri L S Saini, Md Nadeem Ahmad, Mr Umesh Burnwal, Mr Siddharth Gill, and other lawyer colleagues who appeared for other accused persons and did their best. I am extremely thankful to 16 residents of my constituency who were made co-accused with me and they stood with me firmly like a rock. I am very thankful to my family who always stood by me through thick and thin. I am also thankful to my party especially my leader @ArvindKejriwal ji who never believed in the allegations and in fact when @_YogendraYadav ji and @pbhushan1 ji wanted me to resign because of these allegations then Arvind ji had said that for standing with people of his area, Somnath needs to be applauded and not punished. I vividly remember the way @SanjayAzadSln ji had supported me in the meeting and during the entire journey. I have no words to thank my leaders and my colleagues and volunteers in the party. I am also thankful to people of my assembly constituency who never believed in the allegations and elected me twice after the alleged incident and rather with much bigger margins of 16000 and 18200 compared to the first time margin of 8000. Hope print and electronic media gives the acquittal as much coverage as they gave during those days in condemning me, local residents and my party for something which should have been applauded. सत्यमेव जयते!

What does it mean to rethink incarceration in America? In our recent episode of The Last Mile Radio, @lbeisen Eisen, Senior Director of the Justice Program at the Brennan Center for Justice, breaks down the thinking behind one of the most comprehensive reports on prison reform released this year. The @BrennanCenter report examines a system that has failed on multiple levels. It looks at the lived experience of incarceration, the impact on families, and the toll on correctional staff who operate in high-stress, often unsafe environments every day. It also highlights a critical gap, most prisons are not equipped to address the root causes that lead people there in the first place, including lack of education, job access, and mental health support. At the same time, the report identifies where real momentum for change is sprouting: Across the country, there are programs working inside correctional systems to reduce violence, improve daily conditions, and create pathways for successful reentry. Organizations like The Last Mile are part of that effort, partnering directly with departments of corrections to build practical, scalable solutions. The report brings these efforts together in one place, showing how different models are beginning to reshape what incarceration can look like when dignity, safety, and opportunity are prioritized. This is why the report matters. It does not just describe what is broken. It documents what is working, and why it works. His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri, Prof. Dr. Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri, Chairman Supreme Council, MQI, and Dr. Ghazala Qadri, President MWL International, participated in a meeting with the Women’s Forum and female leads of MQI Norway. Office bearers were given the opportunity to introduce themselves before the session commenced with Qur’an recitation by Farah Batool from Minhaj Halqa-e-Durood, followed by a nasheed presented by sisters from various forums under the leadership of Anjum Butt, Minhaj Halqa-e-Durood. The theme of the day focused on our understanding of religion and how we practice it. Shaykh-ul-Islam emphasized that Islam is not limited to temporary rituals but is a lifelong practice that should shape every aspect of life. His Eminence noted that many people today practice religion in a seasonal manner, which creates a distance between faith and daily life. His Eminence further explained that religion should become a natural part of our thinking, actions, and environment, rather than something separated from everyday life. Just as societal rules provide freedom within limits, religion also grants freedom within defined boundaries. It was further highlighted that religion is about discipline and structure rather than restriction. A lack of consistent religious practice has led to identity challenges, particularly among youth. Therefore, the role of parents is crucial, and religious initiatives must focus on developing lasting values so that faith becomes a natural part of life. During the program, shields were also presented to office bearers who demonstrated outstanding performance, including: Sameen Shabbir (Finance Secretary), Saira Nisar (Minhaj Women Forum, Kløfta), Iqra Ejaz Ahmed and Khadijah Mahmood (Learning and Development). Several sisters from different forums were also awarded diplomas in recognition of their contributions. Among the participants were Sameen Shabbir (Deputy Finance Secretary, NEC), Nazia Batool (President, MHD Norway and President, MWL Europe), Samina Ishaq (President, MWL Oslo), Saira Nisar (President, MWL Kløfta), Halima Siddique (President, MWL Drammen), Iqra Mushtaq Khan (President, MS), Ayesha Khan (President, MDF), Iqra Ejaz Ahmed (Lead, Learning and Development), and Nazima Ansari (Lead, Marketing and Social Media). Members of the NEC leadership of MQI Norway were also present, including Awais Ejaz (President), Zartash Bashir (Vice President), Hassan Bashir (General Secretary), Atif Rauf (Finance Secretary), and Ata-ul-Mustafa Mahmood (Deputy Secretary). #DrTahirUlQadri #norway #womenleague #MinhajulQuran

नागपूर येथे शक्ती आणि सेवेचा संगम; भारतदुर्गा मंदिर व अत्याधुनिक रुग्णालयाचे भूमिपूजन रा. स्व. संघाचे सरसंघचालक डॉ. मोहनजी भागवत यांच्या हस्ते आणि मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस व केंद्रीय मंत्री नितीन गडकरी यांच्या उपस्थितीत आज नागपूर येथे डॉ. आबाजी थत्ते सेवा आणि संशोधन संस्थेच्या मध्य भारतातील अत्याधुनिक मल्टीस्पेशालिटी आणि सुपर स्पेशलिटी 461 बेडचे रुग्णालय ‘नॅशनल हेल्थ केअर इन्स्टिट्यूटचे’ भूमिपूजन व कोनशिला अनावरण करण्यात आले. तसेच डॉ. आबाजी थत्ते सेवा व संशोधन संस्थेद्वारे संचालित भारतदुर्गा मंदिराचे भूमिपूजन व कोनशिला अनावरण करण्यात आले. यावेळी आयोजित धर्मसभा येथे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी उपस्थितांना संबोधित केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यावेळी म्हणाले, भारतदुर्गा मंदिराच्या भूमिपूजनाला संतांचा आशीर्वाद लाभला आहे. देशातील सर्वार्थाने सुंदर आणि शक्तिशाली मंदिर उभे राहील, तसेच देशातील सर्वोत्तम रुग्णालयांपैकी एक रुग्णालय येथे उभारले जात आहे. ‘नॅशनल हेल्थ केअर इन्स्टिट्यूट’चा मुख्य उद्देश गरिबांपर्यंत दर्जेदार उपचार आणि आरोग्यसेवा पोहोचवणे हा आहे. त्याच हेतूने या संस्थेची स्थापना करण्यात आली आहे. याच अंतर्गत ४६१ खाटांचे मल्टीस्पेशालिटी आणि सुपर स्पेशालिटी रुग्णालय उभारण्यात येत आहे. हे इन्स्टिट्यूट दर्जाच्या बाबतीत कॉर्पोरेट रुग्णालयांच्या तोडीस तोड असेल, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. यावेळी मंत्री चंद्रशेखर बावनकुळे, राज्यमंत्री ॲड. आशिष जयस्वाल, नागपूरच्या महापौर निता ठाकरे, श्री कार्ष्णि पीठाधीश्वर पूज्य श्री गुरु शरणानंदजी महाराज, जुनापीठाधिश्वर आचार्य महामंडलेश्वर पूज्य स्वामी अवधेशानंद गिरीजी महाराज, श्रीराम जन्मभूमी तीर्थक्षेत्र ट्रस्टचे कोषाध्यक्ष पूज्य स्वामी गोविंददेव गिरीजी महाराज, पूज्य स्वामी मित्रानंदजी महाराज, पद्मभूषण दीदी माँ पूज्य साध्वी ऋतंभराजी, बागेश्वर धाम सरकार चे पीठाधीश्वर पूज्य पं. धीरेन्द्र शास्त्रीजी, एनसीआयचे अध्यक्ष ॲड. सुनील मनोहर, एनसीआयचे सीईओ शैलेश जोगळेकर व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @DrMohanBhagwat @Dev_Fadnavis @nitin_gadkari @cbawankule @Ashishjaisw3Adv @GovindaDevGiri @DidiRitambhara @bageshwardham #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #BharatDurga #DharamSabha

Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam: CPI (M)state Secretary MV Govindan says, "When the election results come out, the LDF will return to power with a strong majority. There is no possibility of the UDF forming the government. The internal conflicts within them will last only until May 4. During the election period, the UDF had alleged that the LDF had an understanding with the BJP. What has actually happened is becoming clear day by day. In constituencies like Nadapuram and Vadakara, the BJP helped the UDF. It is evident that a section of the BJP was made to function as part of the UDF."

Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam: CPI (M)state Secretary MV Govindan says, "The controversy created by a group over the incident where a Christian song was sung by Nandagovindam Bhajans at a temple is part of an attempt to disrupt communal harmony. It is Hindu communal extremists who have come forward against Nandagovindam Bhajans. We have seen various expressions of communal harmony upheld in Kerala. Such people are trying to cut that down. Some are also widely spreading propaganda that the government is misappropriating Devaswom Board funds. The attack against Nandagovindam Bhajans is a continuation of this."

Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam: CPI (M)state Secretary MV Govindan says, "The suicide of Nithin Raj at the Ancharakandi Dental College in Kannur is deeply serious. This incident is evidence that caste discrimination still persists. Reports are emerging that students are being continuously harassed. A strong and serious response is required. Vigilance must be maintained against such incidents. Even if it is an isolated case, it must be treated with utmost seriousness. Careful and prompt intervention is needed to arrest those responsible."
